messages:
tara: Quick sync — need final runbook for the Elysian silicon preview. They want a step-by-step we can hand to their lab tomorrow. Key items: NDA signed, bench scripts, telemetry hooks, and a 48h feedback loop.

jake: I can draft the bench checklist. What's the target SLOs we commit to for the preview? latency/throughput numbers?

maria: Elysian asked for a baseline perf run + two optimized configs (quant + kv-cache). We promised 99th p99 < 120ms for 8k context in the email thread. Is that still where we aim?

tara: Yes — p99 < 120ms is the customer-facing number. Internally we'll record raw token/sec and cost-per-token. Also add cold-start numbers.

elysian-eng: (from partner) Thanks — we'll have lab access 10:00 PT tomorrow. NDA e-signed (DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/elysian). Need the runbook by EOD. Can you include the exact docker image + kernel flags?

samir: Adding kernel flags + recommended docker tag. Proposed command snippet:

```bash
docker run --gpus all -e REDWOOD_ENV=preview 
  -v /mnt/models:/models 
  redwood/inference:preview-quant-v2 \
  --kernels=warp-attn,kv-cache-opt --max-seq=8192
```

samir: Also include the perf script we'll run: `scripts/bench/throughput.sh --context 8192 --batch 4 --duration 300`

jake: Great. I'll write the bench checklist sections: prereqs, run order (baseline, quantized, cache-enabled), data collection points (latency, tokens/s, mem, GPU util, syscalls if any), and the plotting script.

olivia: On telemetry — we need a minimal payload to send back to our side (anonymized). Elysian requested raw logs for low-level debugging but legal flagged that.

legal-bot: Reminder from Legal: partner-provided raw logs may contain proprietary data. Obtain explicit consent and ensure PII is redacted. Use our redaction script before transfer: `tools/redact/strip-pii.py`.

maria: We'll ask Elysian to filter to perf counters only. If they insist on logs, use S3 with limited retention + kms key. Add this to runbook.

tara: Feedback loop — propose daily standups for first 3 days (30m), then async updates. We'll collect issues as GitHub issues in `rwd/elysian-preview`. Can someone create the repo and template?

jake: I'll create the repo and an issue template: `bug`, `regression`, `tuning-suggestion`. Will also add a triage checklist.

elysian-eng: Sounds good. For regressions we want automated alerting tied to our telemetry thresholds. Can you share thresholds in the runbook?

samir: Thresholds: baseline token/s drop >10% = alert; p99 latency >120ms = P0; GPU mem spike >85% = investigate. I'll add exact metrics and example Grafana queries.

olivia: Who owns on-call during the preview? We should define primary + backup and escalation path.

tara: Primary: maria, backup: jake. If both out, escalate to infra-oncall. Add contact numbers and Slack huddles link.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deployment to preview namespace at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Image: redwood/inference:preview-quant-v2.

jake: Nice. One more: dependency matrix — list of supported CUDA + driver versions, kernel module reqs. Elysian lab runs mixed firmware; add compatibility notes.

elysian-eng: We'll provide firmware list. We also have a patch that improves memcpy perf on their new boards; can we test with and without?

maria: Add an A/B test step: run identical bench with firmware v1 (stock) and v1-patch. Tag artifacts clearly.

tara: I'll compile everything into a single runbook doc and send a read-only Google Drive link to Elysian once updated. Jake + Samir + Olivia please review the first draft in #partnerships today.

jake: On it — aiming to push draft by 16:00 PT.

maria: I'll prepare the redaction + S3 retention policy text.

elysian-eng: Thanks all — excited to get this running. See you tomorrow 10:00 PT. :rocket:

tara: Thanks team :thumbsup:
